owner.description: Ticket id, spike id, or constraint id whose acceptance or meter this evidence supports

commit.description: The head the evidence was verified at. A historical fact, not a pin to keep current: later commits and rebases do not make it stale

command.description: Host-neutral command that produced the files

host.description: Recorded fact, not a pass criterion

result.description: Outcome at the verified head; not_met and owed record an honest gap instead of a pass

sha256.description: Required by STR-005 on every file of a benchmark, stat_threshold, or visual_regression manifest and on a file whose role starts with baseline or measurement, because a later run compares against it; optional otherwise

role.description: Free text; conventional values are baseline, log, screenshot, measurement, transcript, summary. A role starting with baseline or measurement requires sha256

pass_criteria.description: What a later run must satisfy, distinct from the recorded values
